parameters.name: AlbServerGroup
parameters.description: The information about ALB server groups.

sub_parameters.name: AlbServerGroupId
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the ALB server group.

N is the serial number of the ALB server group. The number of ALB server groups that can be associated with a scaling group is limited. To view or request a quota increase, go to [Quota Center](https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas).

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description:
The port number used by the ECS instance after Auto Scaling adds the instance to the ALB server group. Valid values: 1 to 65535.

N is the serial number of the ALB server group.

> If N is the same but Port is different, the system associates multiple ALB server groups with different ports to the scaling group.

sub_parameters.name: Weight
sub_parameters.description:
The weight of an ECS instance as a backend server after Auto Scaling adds the instance to the ALB server group. A higher weight indicates that the instance receives more access requests. If the weight is 0, the instance does not receive access requests. Valid values: 0 to 100.

N is the serial number of the ALB server group.

parameters.name: AllocationStrategy
parameters.description:
The capacity allocation strategy that determines how the scaling group selects available instance types to meet capacity requirements. The capacity allocation strategy applies to both pay-as-you-go and spot capacity. This parameter takes effect only when `MultiAZPolicy` is set to `COMPOSABLE`. Valid values:

- priority: instances are created in the order of the configured instance types.
- lowestPrice: instances are created in ascending order of vCPU unit price.

Default value: priority.

parameters.name: AutoRebalance
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic rebalancing for the scaling group. This parameter takes effect only when BalancedOnly is enabled for a zone-balanced scaling group. Valid values:
- false: Disables automatic rebalancing.
- true: Enables automatic rebalancing. The scaling group automatically detects capacity across zones. When zone capacity is imbalanced, the system proactively performs scale-in and scale-out operations to rebalance capacity across zones.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: AzBalance
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to evenly distribute the capacity of the scaling group across multiple zones. This parameter takes effect only when `MultiAZPolicy` is set to `COMPOSABLE`. Valid values:
- true: the capacity of the scaling group is evenly distributed across multiple zones.
- false: the capacity of the scaling group is not evenly distributed across multiple zones.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: BalanceMode
parameters.description:
The zone balancing mode. This parameter takes effect only when zone balancing is enabled. Valid values:

- BalancedBestEffort: If resource creation fails in a zone, the system falls back to other zones to ensure best-effort resource delivery.

- BalancedOnly: If resource creation fails in a zone, the system does not fall back to other zones. The scaling activity partially succeeds to prevent excessive imbalance of resources across zones.

Default value: BalancedBestEffort.

parameters.name: CapacityOptions
parameters.description: The capacity options.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a value from your client that is unique among different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: CompensateWithOnDemand
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically create pay-as-you-go instances to meet the required number of ECS instances when spot instances cannot be created due to price or inventory reasons. This parameter takes effect only when `MultiAZPolicy` is set to `COST_OPTIMIZED`. Valid values:

- true: allowed.
- false: not allowed.

Default value: true.

parameters.name: ContainerGroupId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the ECI instance, which is the container group ID.

parameters.name: CustomPolicyARN
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the custom scale-in policy (Function). This parameter takes effect only when the first removal policy in RemovalPolicies is set to CustomPolicy.

parameters.name: DBInstance
parameters.description: The list of databases associated with the scaling group.

sub_parameters.name: AttachMode
sub_parameters.description:
The mode in which the scaling group is associated with the database. Valid values:

- SecurityIp: IP whitelist mode. Scaled-out instances are automatically added to the IP whitelist of the database. Only RDS databases are supported.
- SecurityGroup: Security group mode. The security group specified in the scaling configuration is added to the security group whitelist of the database, which allows instances in the security group to access the database.

sub_parameters.name: DBInstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The database instance ID.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the database. Valid values:

- RDS.
- Redis.
- MongoDB.

Default value: RDS.

parameters.name: DBInstanceIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of ApsaraDB RDS instances. The value is a JSON array that consists of ApsaraDB RDS instance IDs separated by commas (,). 

<props="china">The total number of ApsaraDB RDS instances that can be associated with a single scaling group depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to [Quota Center](https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas) to view the quota for **Total Number of RDS Instances That Can Be Associated with a Scaling Group**.</props>

<props="intl">The total number of ApsaraDB RDS instances that can be associated with a single scaling group depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to [Quota Center](https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas) to view the quota for **Total Number of RDS Instances That Can Be Associated with a Scaling Group**.</props>

<props="partner">The total number of ApsaraDB RDS instances that can be associated with a single scaling group depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to Quota Center to view the quota for **Total Number of RDS Instances That Can Be Associated with a Scaling Group**.</props>

parameters.name: DefaultCooldown
parameters.description:
The cooldown time after a scaling activity (adding or removing instances) is complete. Valid values: 0 to 86400. Unit: seconds.

During the cooldown time, the scaling group does not execute other scaling activities. This applies only to scaling activities triggered by CloudMonitor event-triggered tasks.  

Default value: 300.

parameters.name: DesiredCapacity
parameters.description: The expected number of instances in the scaling group. The scaling group automatically maintains the number of ECS instances at the expected number of instances. The value must not be greater than MaxSize or less than MinSize.

parameters.name: GroupDeletionProtection
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection for the scaling group. Valid values:

- true: enables deletion protection. The scaling group cannot be deleted.
- false: disables deletion protection.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: GroupType
parameters.description:
The type of instances managed by the scaling group. Valid values:

- ECS: the scaling group manages ECS instances.

- ECI: the scaling group manages Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances.

Default value: ECS.

parameters.name: HealthCheckType
parameters.description:
The health check mode of the scaling group. Valid values:

- NONE: no health check is performed.
- ECS: health checks are performed on instances in the scaling group (this value is used to enable instance health checks for both ECS-type and ECI-type scaling groups).
- LOAD_BALANCER: the instance health status is determined based on load balancing health check results (CLB-type load balancing is not supported).

Default value: ECS.

> To enable both instance health checks and load balancing health checks, use the `HealthCheckTypes` parameter.

parameters.name: HealthCheckTypes
parameters.description:
The health check mode of the scaling group.
> You can specify multiple values for this parameter to enable multiple health check options. If the `HealthCheckType` parameter is specified, this parameter is ignored.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance. When you create a scaling group, the required configuration information is obtained from the specified instance, and a scaling configuration is created through automatic creation.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the launch template from which the scaling group obtains launch configuration information.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateOverride
parameters.description: The launch template override information.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceType
sub_parameters.description:
When you want the scaling group to scale based on the capacity of instance types, specify both this parameter and LaunchTemplateOverride.N.WeightedCapacity.

This parameter specifies the instance type and overrides the instance type in the launch template. You can specify N values for this parameter to extend the launch template to support N instance types. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
> This parameter takes effect only when the LaunchTemplateId parameter specifies a launch template.

Valid values of InstanceType: ECS instance types that are available for purchase. For more information, see [Instance families](~~25378~~).

sub_parameters.name: SpotPriceLimit
sub_parameters.description:
The maximum bid price for the instance type specified by `LaunchTemplateOverride.N.InstanceType`. You can specify N values for this parameter to extend the launch template to support N instance types. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
> This parameter takes effect only when the `LaunchTemplateId` parameter specifies a launch template.

sub_parameters.name: WeightedCapacity
sub_parameters.description:
When you want the scaling group to scale based on the capacity of instance types, specify this parameter after you specify LaunchTemplateOverride.N.InstanceType. The two parameters correspond to each other, and N must be consistent.

This parameter specifies the weight of the instance type, which represents the capacity of a single instance of this type in the scaling group. A higher weight means fewer instances of this type are needed to meet the expected capacity.

Because instance types differ in the number of vCPUs, memory size, and other performance metrics, you can assign different weights to different instance types based on your requirements.

Example:

- Current capacity: 0.
- Expected capacity: 6.
- Capacity of ecs.c5.xlarge: 4.

To meet the expected capacity, the scaling group scales out 2 ecs.c5.xlarge instances.

> During scale-out events, the capacity of the scaling group must not exceed the sum of the maximum capacity (MaxSize) and the maximum weight of the instance types.

Valid values of WeightedCapacity: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateVersion
parameters.description:
The version of the launch template. Valid values: 
         
- A fixed template version number.
- Default: always uses the default version of the template.
- Latest: always uses the latest version of the template.

parameters.name: LifecycleHook
parameters.description: The lifecycle hook information.

sub_parameters.name: DefaultResult
sub_parameters.description:
The action to take after the wait state ends. Valid values:

- CONTINUE: continues to respond to the scale-out activity or continues to respond to the scale-in activity.
- ABANDON: releases ECS instances created during scale-out events or removes ECS instances from the scaling group during scale-in events.

When a scale-in event (SCALE_IN) occurs in the scaling group and triggers multiple lifecycle hooks, if the wait state of a lifecycle hook with DefaultResult set to ABANDON ends, the wait states of other corresponding lifecycle hooks end early. In other cases, the next action is determined by the last lifecycle hook whose wait state ends.

Default value: CONTINUE.

sub_parameters.name: HeartbeatTimeout
sub_parameters.description:
The wait time set by the lifecycle hook for the scaling activity. After the wait state times out, the next action is taken. Valid values: 30 to 21600. Unit: seconds.

After a lifecycle hook is created, you can call the [RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat](~~73846~~) operation to extend the wait time of an ECS instance, or call the [CompleteLifecycleAction](~~73847~~) operation to end the wait state of a scaling activity early.

Default value: 600.

sub_parameters.name: LifecycleHookName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the lifecycle hook. The name cannot be modified after it is specified. If not specified, the default value is the lifecycle hook ID.

sub_parameters.name: LifecycleTransition
sub_parameters.description:
The type of scaling activity to which the lifecycle hook applies. Valid values:

- SCALE_OUT: scale-out events of the scaling group.
- SCALE_IN: scale-in events of the scaling group.

> If a lifecycle hook is specified for the scaling group, this parameter is required. Other related parameters are optional.

sub_parameters.name: NotificationArn
sub_parameters.description:
The identifier of the notification object for the lifecycle hook. The following types of notification objects are supported: Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) queues and topics. The parameter value is in the format of acs:ess:{region}:{account-id}:{resource-relative-id}.

- region: the region where the scaling group resides.
- account-id: the Alibaba Cloud account ID.

Examples:

- MNS queue: acs:ess:{region}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}.
- MNS topic: acs:ess:{region}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}.

sub_parameters.name: NotificationMetadata
sub_parameters.description: The fixed string information for the wait state of a scaling activity. The value cannot exceed 128 characters in length. Each time Auto Scaling pushes a notification to the Notification Recipient, it also sends the predefined NotificationMetadata parameter value, which helps you manage and mark notification information of different categories. This parameter takes effect only when the NotificationArn parameter is also specified.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerConfig
parameters.description: The list of Classic Load Balancer (CLB) (formerly SLB) load balancing configurations.

sub_parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) (formerly SLB) load balancing instance.

sub_parameters.name: Weight
sub_parameters.description:
The weight of the instance as a backend server after Auto Scaling adds the instance to the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) (formerly SLB) load balancing server group. A higher weight indicates that the instance is allocated more access requests. If the weight is 0, the instance does not receive access requests.

Valid values: 0 to 100.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of CLB (formerly SLB) instances. The value is a JSON array that consists of CLB instance IDs separated by commas (,).

<props="china">The total number of CLB instances that can be associated with a single scaling group depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to [Quota Center](https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas) to view the quota for **Total Number of Load Balancing Instances That Can Be Associated with a Scaling Group**.</props>

<props="intl">The total number of CLB instances that can be associated with a single scaling group depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to [Quota Center](https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas) to view the quota for **Total Number of Load Balancing Instances That Can Be Associated with a Scaling Group**.</props>

<props="partner">The total number of CLB instances that can be associated with a single scaling group depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to Quota Center to view the quota for **Total Number of Load Balancing Instances That Can Be Associated with a Scaling Group**.</props>

parameters.name: MaxInstanceLifetime
parameters.description:
The maximum amount of time that an instance can exist in the scaling group. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: `[86400, Integer.maxValue]`.

Default value: null.
> This parameter is not supported for ECI-type scaling groups or scaling groups with the economical mode enabled.

parameters.name: MaxSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of instances in the scaling group. When the number of instances in the scaling group is greater than the value of `MaxSize`, Auto Scaling automatically removes instances. 

<props="china">The value range of MaxSize depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to [Quota Center](https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas) to view the quota for **Maximum Number of Instances in a Scaling Group**.</props>

<props="intl">The value range of MaxSize depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to [Quota Center](https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas) to view the quota for **Maximum Number of Instances in a Scaling Group**.</props>

<props="partner">The value range of MaxSize depends on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to Quota Center to view the quota for **Maximum Number of Instances in a Scaling Group**.</props>

If the quota for **Maximum Number of Instances in a Scaling Group** is 2000, the value range of `MaxSize` is 0 to 2000.

parameters.name: MinSize
parameters.description:
The minimum number of instances in the scaling group. When the number of instances in the scaling group is less than the value of `MinSize`, Auto Scaling uses automatic creation to create instances. 

> The value of `MinSize` must be less than or equal to the value of `MaxSize`.

parameters.name: MultiAZPolicy
parameters.description:
The scaling policy for ECS instances in a multi-zone scaling group. Valid values: 
         
- PRIORITY: the vSwitch specified first (VSwitchIds.N) has the highest priority. Auto Scaling preferentially attempts to scale instances in the zone where the highest-priority vSwitch resides. If the scaling cannot be completed, Auto Scaling automatically attempts to scale instances in the zone where the next-priority vSwitch resides.  
- COST_OPTIMIZED: during scale-out events, Auto Scaling attempts to create ECS instances in ascending order of vCPU unit price. During scale-in events, Auto Scaling attempts to remove ECS instances in descending order of vCPU unit price. If the scaling configuration specifies multiple instance types with preemptible billing methods, spot instances are preferentially created. You can use the CompensateWithOnDemand parameter to specify whether to automatically create pay-as-you-go instances when spot instances cannot be created due to insufficient inventory. 

    > COST_OPTIMIZED takes effect only when the scaling configuration specifies multiple instance types or uses spot instances. 
- BALANCE: ECS instances are evenly allocated across the multiple active zones specified for the scaling group. If instances become unevenly distributed across zones due to insufficient inventory, you can call the [RebalanceInstance](~~71516~~) operation to rebalance resources.  
- COMPOSABLE: a composable strategy that allows you to combine the preceding multi-zone scaling policies as needed, or further specify parameters for more fine-grained control over the capacity of the scaling group.

Default value: PRIORITY.

parameters.name: OnDemandBaseCapacity
parameters.description:
The minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances required in the scaling group. Valid values: 0 to 1000. When the number of pay-as-you-go instances is less than this value, pay-as-you-go instances are preferentially created. 

When `MultiAZPolicy` is set to `COMPOSABLE`, the default value is 0.

parameters.name: OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity
parameters.description:
The percentage of pay-as-you-go instances among the excess instances after the minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances (OnDemandBaseCapacity) is met. Valid values: 0 to 100.

When `MultiAZPolicy` is set to `COMPOSABLE`, the default value is 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group. For more information, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: RemovalPolicy.1
parameters.description:
The first-round filter strategy for the scale-in policy. The value must be different from the values of RemovalPolicy.2 and RemovalPolicy.3. Valid values:

- OldestInstance: removes the ECS instance that was earliest added to the scaling group.
- NewestInstance: removes the ECS instance that was most recently added to the scaling group.
- OldestScalingConfiguration: removes the ECS instance that was created based on the earliest scaling configuration.
- CustomPolicy: removes ECS instances based on a custom scale-in policy (Function).

The scaling configuration mentioned in OldestScalingConfiguration refers to the instance configuration source in the scaling group, including scaling configurations and launch templates. CustomPolicy can only be set as the first-round scale-in policy. When you specify CustomPolicy, you must also specify the CustomPolicyARN parameter.

> The removal of ECS instances from a scaling group is also affected by the scaling policy (MultiAZPolicy) of the scaling group. For more information, see [Configure a combination policy for removing instances](~~254822~~).

parameters.name: RemovalPolicy.2
parameters.description:
The second-round filter strategy for the scale-in policy. The value must be different from the values of RemovalPolicy.1 and RemovalPolicy.3. Valid values:

- OldestInstance: removes the ECS instance that was earliest added to the scaling group.
- NewestInstance: removes the ECS instance that was most recently added to the scaling group.
- OldestScalingConfiguration: removes the ECS instance that was created based on the earliest scaling configuration.

> The removal of ECS instances from a scaling group is also affected by the scaling policy (MultiAZPolicy) of the scaling group. For more information, see [Configure a combination policy for removing instances](~~254822~~).

parameters.name: RemovalPolicy.3
parameters.description:
The third-round filter strategy for the scale-in policy. The value must be different from the values of RemovalPolicy.1 and RemovalPolicy.2. Valid values:

- OldestInstance: removes the ECS instance that was earliest added to the scaling group.
- NewestInstance: removes the ECS instance that was most recently added to the scaling group.
- OldestScalingConfiguration: removes the ECS instance that was created based on the earliest scaling configuration.

> The removal of ECS instances from a scaling group is also affected by the scaling policy (MultiAZPolicy) of the scaling group. For more information, see [Configure a combination policy for removing instances](~~254822~~).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the newly created scaling group belongs.
> The newly created scaling group is added to the specified resource group. If you do not specify this parameter, the scaling group is added to the default resource group.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupName
parameters.description:
The name of the scaling group. The name must be unique within a region.

The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). It must start with a digit, letter, or Chinese character.

Default value: the value of ScalingGroupId.

parameters.name: ScalingPolicy
parameters.description:
Specifies the reclaim pattern of the scaling group. Valid values: 

- recycle: the scaling group uses the shutdown and reclaim pattern.  
- release: the scaling group uses the release pattern.
- forcerelease: the scaling group uses the forced release pattern.

    > If you select `forcerelease`, running instances are forcefully released during scale-down activities. A forced release is equivalent to a power-off operation, which erases temporary data in the memory and storage of the instance. The data cannot be recovered. Proceed with caution.

- forcerecycle: the scaling group uses the forced shutdown and reclaim pattern.

    > If you select `forcerecycle`, running instances are forcefully shut down during scale-down activities. A forced shutdown is equivalent to a power-off operation, which erases temporary data in the memory and storage of the instance. The data cannot be recovered. Proceed with caution.

ScalingPolicy specifies the revoke pattern of the scaling group. The specific action taken when an instance is removed from the scaling group is determined by the RemovePolicy parameter of RemoveInstances. For more information, see [RemoveInstances](~~25955~~).

parameters.name: ServerGroup
parameters.description:
The information about load balancing server groups.
> You cannot specify the same server group information in both `AlbServerGroups` and `ServerGroups`.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description:
The port number used by the ECS instance after Auto Scaling adds the instance to the server group. Valid values: 1 to 65535.

> This parameter is required for ALB and NLB load balancing server groups. This parameter cannot be set for GWLB load balancing server groups, and the default value is 6081.

sub_parameters.name: ServerGroupId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the server group.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the server group. Valid values:

- ALB: Application Load Balancer (ALB).
- NLB: Network Load Balancer (NLB).
- GWLB: Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB).

sub_parameters.name: Weight
sub_parameters.description:
The weight allocated to an ECS instance as a backend server after Auto Scaling adds the instance to the server group. Valid values: 0 to 100.

A higher weight indicates that the instance receives more access requests. If the weight is 0, the instance does not receive access requests.

> This parameter is required for ALB and NLB load balancing server groups. This parameter cannot be set for GWLB load balancing server groups.

parameters.name: SpotAllocationStrategy
parameters.description:
The spot capacity allocation strategy. You can use this parameter to specify the allocation strategy for spot capacity separately. This parameter takes effect only when `MultiAZPolicy` is set to `COMPOSABLE`. Valid values:

- priority: instances are created in the order of the configured instance types.
- lowestPrice: instances are created in ascending order of vCPU unit price.

Default value: priority.

parameters.name: SpotInstancePools
parameters.description:
The number of available instance types. The scaling group creates spot instances across multiple types at the lowest cost. Valid values: 1 to 10.

When `MultiAZPolicy` is set to `COMPOSABLE`, the default value is 2.

parameters.name: SpotInstanceRemedy
parameters.description: Specifies whether to supplement spot instances. When enabled, the scaling group attempts to create new instances to replace spot instances that are about to be reclaimed after a reclamation notification is received.

parameters.name: StopInstanceTimeout
parameters.description:
The timeout period for waiting for an ECS instance to be stopped during a scale-in process. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 30 to 240.

> - This parameter takes effect only during scale-in processes when ScalingPolicy is set to release.  
- If this parameter is specified, the system waits up to the StopInstanceTimeout period for the instance to stop. After the timeout, the scale-in process continues regardless of whether the instance is stopped.  
- If this parameter is not specified, the system waits indefinitely for the instance to stop. The scale-in process continues only after the instance is stopped. If the instance fails to stop, the scale-in process is rolled back and the scaling activity fails.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of the scaling group.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the scaling group.

sub_parameters.name: Propagate
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the tag is a propagatable tag. Valid values:
- true: tags on the scaling group are propagated only to newly created instances, not to instances that are already running in the scaling group.
- false: tags on the scaling group are not propagated to instances.

Default value: false.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the scaling group.

parameters.name: VServerGroup
parameters.description: The information about the virtual service groups associated with the scaling group.

sub_parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the CLB (formerly SLB) instance to which the virtual service group belongs.

For more information, see [AttachVServerGroups](~~98983~~).

sub_parameters.name: VServerGroupAttribute
sub_parameters.description: The attributes of the backend server group.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description:
The ID of the vSwitch. If you specify this parameter, the network type of the scaling group is VPC.

> If neither VSwitchId nor VSwitchIds.N is specified for the scaling group, the network type of the scaling group defaults to classic network.

parameters.name: VSwitchIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of one or more vSwitches. If you specify the VSwitchIds parameter, the VSwitchId parameter is ignored. If you specify this parameter, the network type of the scaling group is VPC.

When you specify multiple vSwitches:

- The vSwitches must belong to the same VPC.

- The vSwitches can belong to different zones.

- The priority of vSwitches is determined in ascending numerical order, with 1 indicating the highest priority. When an ECS instance cannot be created in the zone where a higher-priority vSwitch resides, the system automatically selects the next-priority vSwitch to create the ECS instance.

> If neither VSwitchId nor VSwitchIds is specified for the scaling group, the network type of the scaling group defaults to classic network.
